original.target_description: Experiment 1 overall item-level recognition discriminability (da), calculated for each word from all self-paced versus all fixed-rate respondents; paired item analysis in p. 112 Results (article p. 4).

n.sample_role: Words/items as paired analytic observations, with one discriminability estimate per condition for each word; 148 participants contribute responses, not 148 item-level observations.
n.exclusions: Four primacy and four recency buffer words excluded from analysis. The explicitly specified 160-word test list comprises the selected nonbuffer words; each participant studied a randomized subset of 80 and was tested on all 160.
